newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Chirac to make public appearance Saturday.
newsitem.headline: France's Chirac to make public appearance Saturday.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac will make his first public appearance on Saturday since his left-wing foes scored a resounding election victory last Sunday.
Chirac's office said on Wednesday the conservative president would address a congress of mutual insurance organisations in the northern city of Lille and open a hospital.
Chirac has been closeted in the Elysee presidential palace since the snap election he called nearly 10 months early backfired, forcing him to share power with Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin.

The vote has also triggered a crisis in his Gaullist RPR party and their UDF centrist allies. Chirac had hoped for their re-election, enabling him to rule in tandem with a friendly parliament until the end of his own term in 2002.
